On August 1, 2026, from 6 p.m., a refined dinner, the Frank Simmons Band and a dance floor going late into the night, in support of Stony Brook Southampton Hospital and East Hampton's emergency care. Tables are snapped up from 15,000 dollars — to be under those tents that evening is to claim the very peak of the Southampton summer.

2026-08-01|68e Summer Party de la Southa.sej_tables0: East Hampton's Italian-Mediterranean institution since 1988, the unapologetic canteen of East End celebrities. Around the wood-burning oven, the kitchen exalts local farms — house-made pappardelle, whole roasted fish — and the table remains more coveted than any other on an August Saturday night.
2026-08-01|68e Summer Party de la Southa.sej_tables1: The Hamptons outpost of the legendary Milanese house, at 30 Main Street in Southampton, minutes from Wickapogue Road. In between, you live Forte dei Marmi like a regular: a cabana in the shade of the pines in the morning, Carrara marble and the Apuan Alps in the afternoon, fish suppers at night, all just a few hundred metres from the two gala venues. A three-night stay (25–28 July), chauffeured car for the evening transfers, white linen de rigueur.

2026-07-26|Notti Toscane 2026 — gala And.sej_hotels1: The historic five-star address of Forte dei Marmi, Viale Morin 169: a private park of umbrella pines, several villas including Villa Agnelli, two heated pools (one seafront with jacuzzi), day spa, fitness, two restaurants and a boat service. Perfect for lunch on the 27th, before the evening at Villa Alpebella.

2026-08-06|Ravello Festival 2026 — Serat.pe: Rick Margitza (formerly with Miles Davis), Jeff Ballard, Andrea Motis, Rita Marcotulli, Dario Deidda

2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.n: Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — masked gala ball of the Venice Carnival
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.dt: Saturday 6 February 2027 (official date announced on ilballodeldoge.com). The theme of the 2027 edition has not yet been revealed; the venue is announced by the authorised ticket office (Scuola Grande della Misericordia), the official website does not yet name it.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.ds: The costumed masked ball created by Antonia Sautter, 34th edition, reputed to be one of the most exclusive events in the world: gala dinner, dancing and performances (opera singers, musicians, burlesque artists, Commedia dell'Arte characters), after-party. Around 400 costumed guests. Period costume (15th-19th c.) strictly compulsory — a plain dinner jacket or day dress will be turned away — available to hire from the Antonia Sautter atelier (more than 1,500 costumes, fittings and accessories included in the Premium/Full categories). Named tickets, from €800 (After Dinner, entry at 00:00) and €1,600 (Doge's Lounge, entry at 23:00) up to €4,000 (section B), €6,000-7,000 (Supreme) and €10,000 (Doge's Imperial Table). Several sections are already sold out for 2027.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.sw: Venice's most closed-door masked ball: four hundred guests in period costume, gala dinner, dancing and performances until dawn — you enter only in eighteenth-century dress, and never by chance.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.ci: The jet-set gala of the Venice Carnival, regularly ranked among the most exclusive parties on the planet, a sumptuous 'see and be seen' spirit in period costume.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.pe: Created by Antonia Sautter. Artistic programme: opera singers, musicians, burlesque artists, dancers and Commedia dell'Arte characters — to date no artist has been named and no international celebrity announced for 2027. An international, costumed high-society crowd.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.iv_g: Ticket categories from €800 (After Dinner) to €10,000 (Doge's Imperial Table); the Premium/Full categories include costume hire at the Antonia Sautter atelier (fittings, accessories)
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.iv_w: Purchase of named tickets (full name of each guest required) online on the official site ilballodeldoge.com, via the authorised ticket office veneziaopera-tickets.eu (event page with purchase button), or by email/telephone through the organiser's office. Period costume compulsory. 50% refund until 28 December 2026, none thereafter (reseller terms).
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.sej_pitch: On Saturday 6 February 2027, Venice returns to its most beautiful lie: the hidden face. We set your trunks down in Cannaregio, a few bridges from the Scuola Grande della Misericordia, between a fifteenth-century palace opening onto the Grand Canal and two starred tables where the lagoon is eaten by the spoonful. A mask shaped by your own hands, a private motoscafo to the threshold of the ball, the return at first light through an empty city: all that is left is to step into the role.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.sej_hotels0: The closest to the ball: a fifteenth-century palace listed as a national monument, Campo Santa Sofia 4198/99 (Ca' d'Oro), Cannaregio — only a few bridges from the Scuola Grande della Misericordia, the venue announced by the ticket office. 42 rooms and suites, a monumental marble staircase, a frescoed ballroom, the L'Alcova restaurant and a panoramic terrace over the Grand Canal, facing the Rialto market. The house where you dress in costume in your own suite and walk there.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.sej_hotels1: Calle Tiepolo 1364, San Polo: one of the eight monumental palaces on the Grand Canal, with private gardens — an absolute rarity in Venice. The Arva restaurant, The Bar and the Palazzo Kitchen Table for a dinner behind closed doors. Spa on the third floor (thermal waters from Salsomaggiore Terme, three treatment rooms, rooftop fitness studio). Arrival by boat from Marco Polo, around 50 minutes; departure by private motoscafo to Cannaregio on the evening of the ball.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.sej_tables0: Two Michelin stars, Calle Tron 1961, Santa Croce. Enrico Bartolini signs the menu, resident chef Donato Ascani stages it: a contemporary reading of lagoon cooking, served in a palace opening onto a garden on the Grand Canal. The dinner of the evening before, the one that sets the tone for the weekend.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.sej_tables1: One Michelin star, Piazza San Marco 121, on the noble floors of the Gran Caffè Quadri, opened in 1775 — the former rooms of the Venetian officers, full-frame windows onto the square. Chef Sergio Preziosa, a rereading of Italian and Venetian classics. The lunch of the day after, masks put away, while the Carnival parades beneath the windows.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.sej_exp0: Dorsoduro 3215: a family atelier that has been shaping Venetian papier-mâché masks entirely by hand since 1984. Small-group making and decorating classes — you leave with the mask you will wear to the ball, moulded and painted by your own hands. The only way never to meet anyone else behind the same face.
2027-02-06|Il Ballo del Doge 2027 — bal.sej_exp1: Fondamenta S. Caterina 3, on the island of Mazzorbo, a step from Burano: the walled vineyard of Dorona di Venezia, the lagoon's native grape, with its cellar, its starred table and its Osteria Contemporanea. A lagoon escape by private boat, a tasting among the vines, lunch facing the water. Seasonal opening to be confirmed for February — we lock the date in at the time of booking.

2026-11-19|3e soirée de gala de la Fonda.ci: Prestige foundation gala at the Palais de Chaillot; Art Deco Foyer de la Danse with an unobstructed view of the Eiffel Tower; long-standing patrons Dior Couture and L'Oréal; an audience of donors, collectors and business leaders.

2026-11-19|3e soirée de gala de la Fonda.sej_hotels1: A contemporary counterpoint in the 16th arrondissement: 7,000 m² designed by Philippe Starck inside a former 1970s postal sorting centre, 59 rooms and 6 suites. 2026-11-19|3e soirée de gala de la Fonda.sej_tables0: In spirit, the table closest to the Trocadéro: Pascal Barbot in the kitchen, Christophe Rohat in the dining room, in the 16th arrondissement. 2026-11-19|3e soirée de gala de la Fonda.sej_tables1: Three Michelin stars in the heart of the Bois de Boulogne, with Frédéric Anton at the helm since 1997, under the Maison Lenôtre banner. 2026-08-09|Gala Starlite 2026 « Peace &.sej_pitch: On 9 August at 8 pm, the Cantera de Nagüeles — a former quarry turned open-air amphitheatre, ringed by sixty-metre rock walls at the foot of the Sierra Blanca — hosts the 17th Starlite Gala, orchestrated as every summer by Sandra García-Sanjuán and Antonio Banderas. 2026-08-09|Gala Starlite 2026 « Peace &.sej_tables1: One star in the 2026 Michelin Guide. 2026-08-09|Gala Starlite 2026 « Peace &.sej_exp0: An operator established in Marbella since 1988 (company iTell Aviation SL), with its own heliport at km 2 of the Carretera de Istán, 29602 Marbella, and a fleet of Bell 505, EC120 and R44. 2026-08-09|Gala Starlite 2026 « Peace &.sej_exp1: More than fifteen high-end motor yachts departing from the Puerto Banús marina, from the SAY 40 day-cruiser to the Sunseeker Predator 72 and the Mangusta 80, via the Princess V58, the Nuvari 64 and the Windy 42 Grand Bora. Qualified professional crew included in all charters, by half-day, full day or several days, with seasonal rates. The perfect day before 9 August: anchoring off the Golden Mile, back to port in the late afternoon, up to the quarry at dusk.

2026-08-16|World Vision Charity Gala 202.sej_pitch: On 16 August 2026, from 8 pm, the Tennis Club at Puente Romano becomes an open-air salon: cocktails and canapés as the sun sinks over the Mediterranean, then a three-course dinner with its wines, before the charity auction led by Daniel Shamoon. Elegant cocktail attire, 350 € per person, in aid of World Vision — a partnership Puente Romano has supported since 2012, in the heart of the Golden Mile.

More than twenty restaurants and bars on site (Nobu, COYA, Cipriani, Sea Grill, La Petite Maison, GAIA, Leña), a Six Senses Spa voted best resort spa in Europe and in Spain at the World Spa Awards 2023, a beach club, pools and gardens facing the sea, on Bulevar Príncipe Alfonso von Hohenlohe.
2026-08-16|World Vision Charity Gala 202.sej_hotels1: Neighbour and twin to Puente Romano, on the same Bulevar Príncipe Alfonso von Hohenlohe, founded in 1954 by Prince Alfonso von Hohenlohe. Both houses belong to the same group and guests enjoy cross access to some of the facilities (pools, fitness, kids club, golf green fee) — to be confirmed at the time of booking.
2026-08-16|World Vision Charity Gala 202.sej_tables0: Two Michelin stars (the first in 2008, the second in 2019), Avenida Cánovas del Castillo 9, in Marbella, about ten minutes' drive from Puente Romano. 2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.dt: Thursday 13 August 2026, from 10:30 am to midnight
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.ds: The Andalusian stage of the Autobello Grand Tour, this automotive concours d'elegance takes place in the gardens of a former cortijo turned resort, in the heart of Sotogrande at the height of the summer season. Contemporary supercars and legendary classics are judged on elegance and exclusivity, alongside fine watchmaking exhibitions. The day flows into a gastronomic lunch, cocktails and an evening party, among a circle of collectors and entrepreneurs.
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.sw: Automotive concours d'elegance and fine watchmaking in the heart of Sotogrande: supercars, classics and collectors.

Special requests by email or via the organisers' WhatsApp (the +34 660 765 934 is a WhatsApp number, not a switchboard).
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.sej_pitch: On 13 August 2026, the gardens of the SO/ Sotogrande Spa & Golf Resort, on the heights of Almenara, host the Andalusian stage of the Autobello Grand Tour: a concours d'elegance where the rarest bodywork of the moment lines up on the lawn, paired with a fine watchmaking exhibition, gourmet offerings and cocktails into the evening. The calendar does the rest: August in Sotogrande is peak polo season, and the clubs of the Guadiaro valley play all month just a few kilometres away. Polo in the afternoon, engines and watches in the evening, and everyone in the same place.
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.sej_hotels0: The very venue of the event: you walk down to the concours d'elegance without getting back in the car. The SO/ (Accor) brand resort occupies the Almenara estate, on the heights of Sotogrande (Avenida Almenara s/n, San Roque, Cádiz). A contemporary thalasso-inspired spa of 3,500 m², several pools, an 18-hole course on the estate (The Alto Club) and access to La Reserva Beach Club. Three in-house tables: Cortijo Santa María 1962, IXO Tapas & Bar and the beach shack MARXA.
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.sej_hotels1: The grand palace hotel of the coast, in Casares (province of Málaga), about twenty minutes' drive east of Sotogrande, between Marbella and the strait. A private estate, suites and residences, a spa of over 2,200 m², an 18-hole course designed by Cabell B. Robinson and a private seafront beach club with a 35-metre infinity pool, minutes from the hotel. Three restaurants on the estate: El Jardín de Lutz, REI and Don Giovanni. Note: it is a base outside Sotogrande, so about twenty minutes' drive on the evening of the Autobello.
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.sej_tables0: The gastronomic table of the Fairmont La Hacienda, on the San Roque coast, a few kilometres from Sotogrande. Gastronomic Andalusian cuisine by Benito Gómez — two Michelin stars for his Bardal, in Ronda — built on seasonality, craftsmanship and local produce, with a menu in constant evolution. Dalmar is recommended by the Michelin Guide, but is not itself starred. Service Tuesday to Saturday, evenings only (7pm-10:30pm); the restaurant also serves an adults-only breakfast.
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.sej_tables1: Sotogrande's seaside institution, Paseo del Parque s/n, set on the site of the legendary El Cucurucho beach club and run by Grupo Trocadero. Interiors by Lorenzo Queipo de Llano, hammocks and sunbeds facing the sea, a pool, a Mediterranean menu year-round and a Thai-Japanese Asian restaurant in summer, cocktails and DJ sessions. No Michelin star, but this is the lunch and the sunset all of Sotogrande shows up for in August. Open daily from 11am to midnight, kitchen from 1pm to 11pm.
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.sej_exp0: Polo is the true backdrop of August in Sotogrande. The Ayala Polo Club, at Hacienda de San Enrique (San Enrique, a few kilometres from Sotogrande's marina), fields three professional grounds, three exercise tracks and one covered arena, and hosts low, medium and high handicap tournaments. The club sells VIP Daily Passes online: it is the most fashionable grandstand of the month, and the natural extension of the afternoon before heading back up to Almenara. The exact match schedule for 13 August should be confirmed directly with the club, which does not publish a detailed programme in advance.
2026-08-13|Autobello Sotogrande 2026.sej_exp1: A sand-bottomed lagoon carved into the hills of La Reserva: 2,800 m² of private beach and chambaos with service, paired with a 17,000 m² sports lagoon (kayak, paddle, electric surf, no motorised craft). An adults-only heated pool with a cocktail bar, SO/ SPA signature treatments, two tables — Ancala (Andalusian, with nikkei and fusion touches, Josper-grilled) and Chiringa, in the chiringuito spirit — plus The Treat Wagon food truck. From June to September, Après Beach evenings with DJs, live music and tapas by Michelin-starred chef Rafael Muria. Open to members and day visitors alike.

The address is one of the anchor points for the international crowd on the Costa del Sol, between Balinese beds, poolside tables and arrivals by sea. The anniversary day is traditionally the most sought-after of the season, on the eve of the 15 August holiday weekend.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.sw: Studio 54 with your feet in the sand: Nikki Beach Marbella turns 23 in disco attire.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.p: Reservation essential for this day: VIP bed, poolside table or a seat at the restaurant, to be requested from the reservations team by phone or email, or via the online booking platform on the official website. 2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.pe: In-house programming by Nikki Beach Marbella; an international crowd of Costa del Sol regulars. No headliner has been announced at this stage.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.iv_o: Nikki Beach Marbella (the beach club's reservations and events team).

2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.iv_w: VIP beds and poolside tables bookable through the reservations team, by phone, email or via the club's online booking platform; minimum spend depending on location, communicated on request.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.sej_pitch: On 14 August 2026, from noon to 7 pm, Nikki Beach Marbella blows out 23 candles with Disco del Sol: a full afternoon when the sands of Elviria dress up in golden tones, mirrors and shimmering silhouettes, to remixes inspired by the late 1970s. On this beach at kilometre 192 of the Carretera de Cádiz, open since 2003, the party runs on Andalusian time — pool and sun loungers facing the Mediterranean, cuisine by executive chef Santiago Zucchi, signature cocktails and entertainment throughout the day. The third chapter in the "Timeless Joy of Celebration" series, it is the rendezvous where the Costa del Sol dances in full sunshine, before heading back up to the Milla de Oro after dark.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.sej_hotels0: The very address of the event: Nikki Beach occupies the Don Carlos beach, in Elviria (Av. Zurita, s/n, 29604 Marbella), at kilometre 192 of the Carretera de Cádiz. A 5-star seafront resort opened in 1969 and reopened in 2025 after a complete renovation: 20,000 m² of gardens running down to the sand, the Don Carlos Spa, the Rafa Nadal Tennis Center, several in-house restaurants (Los Naranjos, Sol y Sombra, Oasis Kitchen, Algrano, Manero Marbella) and two beach clubs, Nikki Beach and Lucia Marbella. Step out of your room and you are already at the party.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.sej_hotels1: Marbella's benchmark palace hotel, on the Milla de Oro (Bulevar Príncipe Alfonso von Hohenlohe, s/n, 29602 Marbella), a member of the Leading Hotels of the World — west of Marbella, so at the opposite end from Elviria: expect a proper car transfer, this is not the beach's own hotel. An Andalusian village by the sea with more than twenty restaurants — Nobu, COYA, Cipriani, La Petite Maison, Sea Grill —, the Six Senses Spa and its legendary tennis club. The choice for those who want to extend the disco day with a night on La Plaza.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.sej_tables0: Two Michelin stars (the first in 2008, the second since 2019), on the edge of Marbella's casco antiguo, Avda. Cánovas del Castillo, 9. The house of sommelier Marcos Granda, with chef Mario Cachinero in the kitchen: contemporary Andalusian haute cuisine and one of the finest food-and-wine pairings in the region. Dinner service only, Monday to Saturday, a tiny dining room: booking essential well before 14 August.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.sej_tables1: One Michelin star in the 2026 guide, avenida Severo Ochoa 12, in town. Opened in 2003 by Argentine chef Mauricio Giovanini, starred without interruption since 2016: a focus on liquid essences and pure juices, between European and Latin American inspirations; his wife Pía Ninci runs the dining room and the cellar. A chef's table for four guests facing the open kitchen, with dishes reserved for those seats.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.sej_exp0: An operator established in Marbella since 1988. Heliport at Carretera de Istán km 2, in Puerto Banús, next to the Manolo Santana Racquet Club (offices at avenida Ricardo Soriano 68). VIP transfers, private flights and flyovers of Puerto Banús, Nueva Andalucía, San Pedro, La Concha and Sierra Blanca, up to the Ronda excursion with wine tasting — aboard Bell 505, EC120 and R44. The most beautiful way to arrive on the coast, or to extend the afternoon with an aerial view over the Mediterranean.
2026-08-14|Disco del Sol — 23rd Annivers.sej_exp1: A charter company based in Puerto Banús (Edificio de Levante 10-B, 29660): motor yachts, sailing boats, fishing boats and vessels for groups, from two hours to a full day, with an English-speaking skipper who knows the waters of the Costa del Sol included, fuel and drinks covered. Departures also possible from Marbella, Estepona or Sotogrande, with open-sea outings or a course set for Sotogrande and Gibraltar — perfect the day before or after Disco del Sol.

For three days, shipowning executives, insurers, registries and shipyards meet on the links for a gathering that is as much a tournament as an informal congress of Greek shipping. Each year the tournament pairs a charitable initiative with its closing ceremony.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.sw: Three days of golf among Greek shipowners, on the links of Costa Navarino.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.p: An occasion aimed at the maritime community: registrations are handled by the organisation through the contact form on the official website, as no address or direct line is published. The stay is booked separately with Costa Navarino.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.pe: Greek and international shipping executives. Maritime sponsors announced on the official website: IRI / The Marshall Islands Registry, Mainline Shipping Company, DNV, Arrow, Standard Club; partners Under Armour, Sixt and Marine Tours.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.iv_o: Greek Maritime Golf Event. The official website names no organising company and no individual organiser.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.iv_g: No free invitations published: the event is aimed at the maritime community, by registration with the organisation.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.iv_w: Go through the contact form on the official website (no email or telephone is published), then book accommodation with Costa Navarino.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.sej_pitch: Three days in September when the elite of Greek and international shipping leaves the boardrooms for the fairways of the Dunes Course. Greece's first signature course, designed by Bernhard Langer with European Golf Design and open since 2010, this par 71 of 6,581 yards unfolds right beside The Romanos and the Westin: links facing the Ionian Sea near the shore, then olive groves and citrus orchards as you climb inland along the Sellas river. Below opens the Bay of Navarino, one of the largest natural harbours in the Mediterranean, where the fleets sunk in the 1827 battle still rest: the most fitting setting there is for a tournament born of the maritime world. Deals are struck on the green as much as at the table, between Navarino Dunes beach and the terraces opening onto the bay.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.sej_hotels0: On the Navarino Dunes estate itself (official address: Navarino Dunes, Messinia, 24001), that is, the site that hosts the Dunes Course: the tournament venue can be reached without taking the car. Rooms from 43 sq m with private infinity pool and uninterrupted views over the Ionian Sea, seafront suites and villas with butler service. Access to the Anazoe Spa, a 4,000 sq m spa and thalassotherapy centre on the same estate, and to some ten dining venues including Barbouni, on the beach. Ranked No. 1 among Greek resorts at the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2024 (US edition).
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.sej_hotels1: The first Mandarin Oriental in Greece, set at Navarino Bay — the second zone of Costa Navarino, a few minutes' drive from Navarino Dunes — facing the historic Bay of Navarino. Suites with bay views and semi-buried villas with private pool, designed for privacy. Waterside wellness area: 25 m pool, olive-wood sauna, plunge pool, hammam and steam rooms. The resort and its spa are rated five stars by the Forbes Travel Guide, and the spa was named World's Best Resort Spa 2025 at the World Spa Awards. Eight dining outlets, from contemporary Greek (Oliviera) to French brasserie.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.sej_tables0: The beachside institution of Navarino Dunes, on the very estate hosting the tournament, attached to The Romanos. Mediterranean seafood cuisine: freshly caught fish and house specialities, feet in the sand facing the Ionian Sea. Note that this is a lunch venue: open daily from 11:00 to 17:30 only — to slot in between two rounds, not for dinner.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.sej_tables1: The chef's table of the Mandarin Oriental, at Navarino Bay: a counter facing the open kitchen, where chef Bertrand Valegeas and his brigade run the service before your eyes. A bespoke menu built on exceptional local produce from the gardens and farms of Messenia. Dinner only on Saturday and Sunday, from 19:30 — to be booked well in advance, as the number of covers is confidential.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.sej_exp0: 4,000 sq m of spa and thalassotherapy centre at the heart of Navarino Dunes, on the very estate of the tournament. 21 treatment rooms, a Heat & Ice zone, hydrotherapy pools opening onto the herb and olive garden, hydromassage baths and ice baths. The signature treatments draw on the health and beauty practices of ancient Greece and on the resources of Messenia — olive oil, herbs, minerals — across five strands including The Messinian Healing and The Kinetics Flow, the latter tailored to muscle recovery. More than twenty international distinctions. The exact counterpoint to three days on the course.
2026-09-04|12th Greek Maritime Golf Even.sej_exp1: The natural extension of a maritime tournament: a private cruise departing from Pylos, in the historic waters of the Bay of Navarino, scene of the 1827 battle. A company based in Pylos and active since 2012, offering half-day or full-day outings. A fleet of seven vessels: motor yachts M/Y Nestor, Nilefs and Sorokos, sailing yacht S/Y Mykines, catamaran S/Y Aria and two speedboats. Tailor-made itineraries to Sfaktiria, Voidokilia, Methoni, Sapientza, Foinikounda or the island of Proti. Skipper, fuel, VAT, wines and a snack included; several boats may be chartered for a group. 2026-10-15|Olympic Yacht Show 2026.sej_pitch: For four days, Olympic Marine — one of the best-equipped marinas in the Mediterranean, at the south-eastern tip of Attica — puts its fleet in the water: motor yachts, sailing yachts and catamarans discovered in their element, pontoons underfoot. You come to step aboard, then you weigh anchor: Kea is three hours' sailing away, and the Cyclades begin there.
2026-10-15|Olympic Yacht Show 2026.sej_hotels0: A 5-star resort set facing the temple of Poseidon, on the Athens-Sounion road, ten minutes from the port of Lavrio — the address closest to the show. Selected by Tatler for its 101 Best Hotels in the World 2026.
2026-10-15|Olympic Yacht Show 2026.sej_hotels1: A 5-star resort spread over a private 72-acre peninsula on the Athenian Riviera, facing the Saronic Gulf. Allow about thirty kilometres by road to the port of Lavrio, and about twenty minutes to Athens airport. Sea-view rooms and beachfront bungalows, villas with private pools, private beaches, spa and wellness. Member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
2026-10-15|Olympic Yacht Show 2026.sej_tables0: One Michelin star awarded in 2021, under chef Luca Piscazzi. Mediterranean cuisine turned towards the sea and seasonal produce, on the Vouliagmeni peninsula — at the far end of the Athenian Riviera, a good hour's drive back up the coast from Lavrio. Dinner only, Monday to Saturday, from 7pm.
2026-10-15|Olympic Yacht Show 2026.sej_tables1: One Michelin star and a Green Star, just nine tables, in the patio of The Margi hotel in Vouliagmeni. Chef Panagiotis Giakalis serves contemporary Greek cuisine built on produce from the house's organic farm. Dinner Tuesday to Sunday, 7pm to 10.30pm. Like Pelagos, it is an evening to plan for: Vouliagmeni is at the opposite end of the Riviera from Lavrio.
2026-10-15|Olympic Yacht Show 2026.sej_exp0: A charter base set on the port of Lavrio itself (Akti Andreas Papandreou), half an hour from Athens airport: recent sailing yachts and catamarans, bareboat or with a skipper. From there, Kea is three hours' sailing away, followed by Kythnos, Serifos, Sifnos and Milos. The temple of Poseidon can also be reached by sea.
2026-10-15|Olympic Yacht Show 2026.sej_exp1: The resort's redesigned spa and the holistic programme devised by osteopath Vicky Vlachonis, structured in four progressive levels of treatment. Panoramic treatment pool facing the temple of Poseidon, a Vicky Vlachonis menu inspired by the Greek diet, and the resort's signature walk — gentle exercise, stretching and meditation facing the sea.

2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.n: Second Story Live at Qurio – Nikki Beach Porto Heli
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.ds: On August 15, the absolute peak of the Greek season, the Qurio rooftop at Nikki Beach Porto Heli hosts the Athenian DJ duo Second Story, billed by the house as world rhythms and immersive sounds beneath the August sky. The resort is the Greek anchor of the Saint-Tropez and Saint-Barth beach-club brand, set in the most sheltered bay of the Peloponnese, facing the yachts at anchor off Porto Heli.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.sw: August 15 on the Nikki Beach rooftop, in the most sheltered bay of the Peloponnese.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.p: Book a table at Qurio through the resort, by phone or email; accommodation is booked through the Nikki Beach Resort & Spa Porto Heli.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.pe: Live set by the Athenian duo Second Story; a crowd of yachtsmen, Porto Heli villa owners and Nikki Beach regulars.

2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.iv_w: Book a table at Qurio through the resort (phone or email), or a room for the night of August 15.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.sej_pitch: On August 15, the day of the greatest feast of the Greek summer, Second Story takes to the roof of the Nikki Beach Resort & Spa Porto Heli. Qurio occupies the hotel's top terrace and opens from 8 pm to 11 pm: signature cocktails, selected wines and exceptional spirits, while the golds of sunset spread across the water and the village of Porto Heli lights up at your feet. Across the water lies Spetses, the island where cars remain off-limits to visitors, a few minutes away by water taxi; behind, the Argolid of the ancient theatres. This tip of the Peloponnese has become the Greek Riviera without ever taking on its noise.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.sej_hotels0: You sleep above the party: Qurio is this hotel's rooftop terrace, open Tuesday to Sunday from 8 pm to 11 pm. 66 rooms and suites, plus 6 villas and bungalows. The resort's beach and pool, the Idolo Spa (treatments blending the wisdom of ancient Greek massage with Greek products), and the Nikki Beach Restaurant for Greek and international cuisine, from breakfast to dinner. Address: Argolida, Peloponnese 21061, Greece.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.sej_hotels1: The region's Aman palace, at Agios Panteleimonas, Kranidi (Argolida), on the heights of the Peloponnese's east coast near Porto Heli. Three families of accommodation: hillside pavilions with sea and countryside views, Beach Pavilions by the water, and villas among the olive trees with private pools. A flagship Aman Spa using natural products, a private beach club, and five dining venues including Akari, the Japanese table. Allow 2.5 hours by road from Athens airport, or 25 minutes by helicopter.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.sej_tables0: The institution of Spetses, founded in 1935 by "Uncle Panos", a fisherman of the island, and still family-run: his son Vasilis and his grandsons Argyris and Nikos. Fresh fish of the day, lobster and slipper lobster, fried calamari, moussaka, saganaki. In Kounoupitsa, open from noon to midnight all year except November and December; booking strongly advised in high summer. Reached from the Kosta pier, next to Porto Heli, in a few minutes by water taxi.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.sej_tables1: An emblematic table of the Old Harbour of Spetses, established since 1991 in the neoclassical building that housed the island's first harbourmaster's office in 1802. Greek flavours served under the stars on what the house claims is the most beautiful terrace in Spetses. Reservations at +30 22980 75255. Same water-taxi crossing from Kosta.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.sej_exp0: Arrive by air rather than by road: HELISTAR S.A., a Greek operator based in Koropi (Pithagora 50 heliport), links Athens with Amanzoe / Kranidi, near Porto Heli, in around 22 minutes of flight. Airbus fleet: AS365 Dauphin, H135, H120. Operations seven days a week from 7 am to 9 pm, on demand.
2026-08-15|Second Story Live at Qurio –.sej_exp1: The great summer event of the Argolid, inland from Porto Heli: the Athens Epidaurus Festival, founded in 1955, stages ancient drama at the Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus — in 2026, The Trojan Women, Antigone, Lysistrata, Ion. The season runs until August 31; check exact dates on the official programme, as changes and cancellations are announced over the summer. Entry to the theatre is forbidden once the performance has begun, except at the interval: so you arrive early — which, at Epidaurus, is the best part of the programme.

Life Cycles brings several generations of leading Greek women artists into dialogue throughout the resort's spaces. An interlude of contemporary art at the heart of the Greek jet set's most discreet enclave, that of the villas and yachts of the Argolid.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.sw: Aman and the Zoumboulakis gallery exhibit all summer above Porto Heli.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.p: The exhibition can be discovered throughout the resort's spaces: book a stay or a table at Amanzoe through reservations.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.pe: Greek women artists from several generations, in collaboration with Zoumboulakis Galleries.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.iv_o: Amanzoe (Aman group), in collaboration with Zoumboulakis Galleries.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.iv_w: Book a stay or a table at Amanzoe: reservations +30 275 4772 863, resort switchboard +30 275 4772 888.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.sej_pitch: From May 22 to October 31, 2026, Amanzoe turns its contemporary acropolis in the hills of Kranidi into an open-air gallery: Life Cycles unfolds sculptures and drawings by four Greek women artists — Marina Karella, Alexandra Athanassiades, Nikomachi Karakostanoglou and Despina Flessa — along the colonnades, in the lavender gardens, in the library and on its terrace, and by the pool. Conceived with Zoumboulakis Galleries, the Athenian house, the exhibition brings the generations into dialogue around continuity, evolution and the eternal. Two "Meet the Artist" gatherings remain this season: Nikomachi Karakostanoglou on Wednesday, September 2, from 4 pm to 8 pm, and Despina Flessa on Wednesday, October 7, from 4 pm to 8 pm, facing the Aegean Sea.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.sej_hotels0: The very site of the exhibition: pavilions, beach pavilions and villas set on a hill above Porto Heli, in the Kranidi hinterland. The works of Life Cycles inhabit its colonnades, lavender gardens, library and terrace, and the areas around the pool. The 2,850 m² Aman Spa adds seven treatment suites, a hammam, sauna, cold plunge, Watsu pool, yoga pavilion, Pilates studio and two floodlit tennis courts; a private Beach Club completes the whole, and the Bostani restaurant serves dinner beneath a great olive tree.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.sej_hotels1: A seaside address on the Greek Riviera, in Porto Heli itself, in the Argolid — a short drive from the Amanzoe hill. 66 rooms and suites plus six villas and bungalows, the brand's signature beach club, the Idolo spa blending ancient Greek massages with Greek products, and the Qurio rooftop for sunsets.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.sej_tables0: A Spetses institution, established since 1991 in the neoclassical building that housed the island's first harbourmaster's office in 1802, at the entrance to the Old Harbour. The house highlights its terrace, which it describes as the most seductive on the island. No Michelin star. Seasonal hours: dinner service every evening from June to September, reduced opening in April-May and October; reservations at +30 22980 75255. From Porto Heli, the crossing to Spetses takes about fifteen minutes by boat.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.sej_tables1: A historic fish taverna on Spetses, founded in 1935 by "barba Panos", a fisherman, and run today by his son Vassilis and his grandsons Argyris and Nikos — three generations in the Kounoupitsa quarter. Catch of the day and seafood. No Michelin star. Open from noon to midnight, but closed in November and December. About fifteen minutes by boat from Porto Heli.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.sej_exp0: A 25-minute flight from Athens International Airport, where the road takes around 2.5 hours: arriving by helicopter lets you land on the hill in the morning and stroll through Life Cycles that very afternoon, before a first dinner beneath the olive tree at Bostani.
2026-05-22|Life Cycles: An Amanzoe Exhib.sej_exp1: About an hour's drive from Kranidi, the ancient theatre of Epidaurus hosts the summer chapter of the Athens & Epidaurus Festival. The 2026 programme announced on the venue's official website includes several ancient tragedies and comedies, among them The Trojan Women, Antigone, Lysistrata and Ion. Detailed programme and dates to be checked on the festival website before booking.

2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.ds: The 87th Hahnenkamm-Rennen run from 18 to 24 January 2027, with the race weekend falling from Friday 22 to Sunday 24. Set right at the finish area of the Streif, the KITZ-RACE-Club is the most exclusive lounge of those three days: private seated grandstand, indoor lounges and fine-dining table, with access granted in advance by the organiser only. On Saturday evening 23 January, the club throws its own party, the KITZRACEParty, extended by a LATENIGHTTicket into the small hours.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.sw: The most exclusive lounge of the Hahnenkamm, right at the Streif finish: private grandstand and Saturday-night party by paid invitation.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.p: No self-service ticketing: club places are requested in advance through the official WWP form (kitz.wwp-group.com/2027/request). 2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.iv_o: WWP Weirather-Wenzel & Partner (WWP Group), which produces and markets the KITZ-RACE-Club; the races themselves are organised by the Kitzbüheler Ski Club.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.iv_g: No free invitations published. Access is through the paid packages below or as a guest of the club's partners; no free quota, no draw and no public waiting list appear on the official materials.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.iv_w: Three paid packages announced for 2027, on request from WWP via the official form: KITZRACEPremium (Friday to Sunday, 22.01–24.01.2027, seated grandstand, club and fine dining) €6,400 net per person; KITZRACEParty (Saturday evening 23.01.2027) €2,400 net; LATENIGHTTicket (Saturday evening, late night) €1,200 net. Austrian VAT of 20% on top. Booking exclusively through the official form.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.sej_pitch: From 22 to 24 January 2027, the Streif reopens for the 87th edition of the Hahnenkamm: Streifalm Super-G on Friday at 11:30, Streif downhill on Saturday at 11:30, Ganslern slalom on Sunday (10:30 and 13:30). At the KITZ-RACE-Club, the race's official VIP club set in the finish area, you follow the Zielschuss at the closest possible range, among skiing legends, executives and faces of the international jet set — atmosphere, table and service worthy of the event. Come evening, Kitzbühel shifts gear: public bib draw, prize-giving ceremonies and celebration in the heart of the Gamsstadt, before the night runs on in the clubs of the Vorderstadt.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.sej_hotels0: Five-star Relais & Châteaux, just 39 rooms and suites, Griesenauweg 26 in Kitzbühel: the view looks straight onto the Hahnenkamm and the Streif. A family house since 1929, with garden park, Spa de Charme (indoor and outdoor pools, sauna, steam bath, massages and treatments), the Tennerhof fine-dining restaurant and Römerhof Stüberl; the centre is about fifteen minutes' walk away.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.sej_hotels1: Five-star in Kitzbühel itself (Ried Kaps 7), beside its small lake and the 9-hole Kaps golf course. Momentum Spa — voted Austria's Best Resort Spa at the World Spa Awards 2025 — with indoor and outdoor pools facing the mountains, panoramic sauna, steam bath, relaxation rooms and a fitness/yoga studio. On the dining side: the DAS Kaps grill-steakhouse and its lakeside terrace, the Rōzu Sushi Lounge and the STREIF restaurant. Rooms and suites in several styles, with balcony, bathtub or mountain view.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.sej_tables0: One star in the MICHELIN Guide 2026, claimed by the house itself. Brasserie and bar led by chef Marc Fröhlich, the alpine version of the Munich address Les Deux by Fabrice Kieffer. Franz-Reisch-Straße 7, right in the centre, a few minutes' walk from the foot of the Hahnenkamm. Open Sunday to Tuesday and Thursday to Friday from 16:00, Saturday from 13:00; closed Wednesday.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.sej_tables1: The restaurant of the Schwarzer Adler hotel, Florianigasse 15, steps from the Vorderstadt. In the kitchen, Jürgen Kleinhappl, once Austria's youngest starred chef, supported in the dining room by sommelier Martina Feyrsinger. Regional, seasonal cooking: Tyrolean specialities, fish, grilled cuts of beef and vegetarian plates, served in the main room, on the terrace or in four wood-panelled stuben.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.sej_exp0: Kitz-Air GmbH, an operator based at the Erpfendorf heliport at the gates of Kitzbühel: private flights for up to five passengers in an AS 350 B3+/B3e, over the Hahnenkamm and the Streif, the Wilder Kaiser, the Kitzbüheler Horn and the Grossglockner. The fleet also includes a Sokol PZL W-3A and a Super Puma, and the company handles VIP and taxi flights — the most elegant way to arrive and leave during race week. Private flight from €549 per aircraft.
2027-01-22|KITZ-RACE-Club — 87es Hahnenk.sej_exp1: Traditionally on the Friday of Hahnenkamm week (2027 date to be confirmed with the organiser), the Stanglwirt, in Going am Wilden Kaiser, turns its Lipizzaner riding arena into the most sought-after of alpine parties: around 2,800 guests, a stage set up in the arena, live concerts, champions and celebrities. More than thirty years of tradition and the only major event of Hahnenkamm week organised by a family. Dress code owned with pride: "Trachtig is prachtig" — dirndl and lederhosen.

2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.dt: From Thursday 14 to Sunday 17 January 2027; days open to VIP ticketing from Friday 15 to Sunday 17 January
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.ds: The 24th edition of the Kitzbühel snow polo world cup takes place on the Reither Wiese, at Reith bei Kitzbühel, facing the Wilder Kaiser massif, from 14 to 17 January 2027. 2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.sw: Kitzbühel snow polo and its Saturday-night black-tie gala: the most fashionable date of the Tyrolean winter.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.p: Named VIP tickets on the official online ticketing platform: Friday 15 January 2027, €340 (10:30-17:00); Saturday 16 January, €390 (10:30-16:30); Sunday 17 January, €390 (10:30-17:00); each ticket includes fine dining and drinks in the VIP tent. Polo Players Gala on Saturday 16 January at 20:00, €400, black tie or cocktail attire. Boxes, hospitality and partnerships: by email to the organiser, Lifestyle Events GmbH in Berlin.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.pe: Organisation: Lifestyle Events GmbH (Reichshofer Strasse 24, 14195 Berlin); title partner: Bendura Bank.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.iv_o: Lifestyle Events GmbH, Reichshofer Strasse 24, 14195 Berlin, organiser of the Snow Polo World Cup Kitzbühel, with Bendura Bank as title partner.

2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.iv_w: VIP tickets on the official online ticketing platform: Friday 15 January 2027, €340 (10:30-17:00); Saturday 16 January, €390 (10:30-16:30); Sunday 17 January, €390 (10:30-17:00), fine dining and drinks included in the VIP tent. Polo Players Gala, Saturday 16 January 2027 at 20:00, €400, black tie or cocktail attire. Boxes, hospitality and partnerships: request by email to the organiser.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.sej_pitch: From 14 to 17 January 2027, the Münichauer / Reither Wiese — the great snow-covered meadow of Reith bei Kitzbühel, a few kilometres from the centre of Kitzbühel — becomes an arena: eight international teams and more than 140 horses contest the 24th edition of the Bendura Bank Snow Polo World Cup, with the Wilder Kaiser as a backdrop. Team presentation on Thursday evening, matches from Friday to Sunday, everything is experienced under the VIP tent — and access is by ticket, to be booked in advance with the organisation. Regulars arrive early: the Kitzbühel Polo Cup, a medium-goal tournament, is played on the same meadow from 7 to 10 January.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.sej_hotels0: Five stars with just 39 rooms, run by the same family since 1929, on the sunny side of Kitzbühel (Griesenauweg 26) — sweeping views over the Streif and the Kitzbühel mountains, a few minutes' drive from the Reith meadow. Spa de Charme with indoor and outdoor pools, sauna, steam bath, massages and treatments. The house table, the Tennerhof Restaurant signed « ein Tirol »: contemporary Tyrolean and international cuisine under chef Kai Horitzky, à la carte or as a four-course menu. Apartments at the Landsitz Römerhof, a step away, for group stays.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.sej_hotels1: Five stars at Going am Wilden Kaiser, facing the very massif that serves as the tournament's backdrop. A house run since 1722, paired with an organic farm, it has been home since 1980 to Austria's first private Lipizzaner stud farm and its twenty-four purebred horses — the most fitting address for a polo weekend, with a riding school and guided rides in the Wilder Kaiser region. Award-winning 1,500 m² spa at the heart of more than 12,000 m² of wellness areas, indoor and outdoor pools, a pool carved into the rock, tennis hall. Around ten kilometres to Kitzbühel.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.sej_tables0: One MICHELIN star 2026, in the very heart of Kitzbühel (Franz-Reisch-Straße 7), a few minutes' drive from the field. A modern French brasserie led by Fabrice Kieffer, with chef Marc Fröhlich at the stove: revisited classics and a bar that carries the evening on. Service from 16:00 on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday, from 13:00 on Saturday. Closed on Wednesday.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.sej_tables1: An institution of Kitzbühel's old town, within the Hotel Schwarzer Adler (Florianigasse 15), a few minutes from the Reith field. The house is run by chef Jürgen Kleinhappl — presented by the establishment as Austria's former youngest starred chef — and Martina Feyrsinger. Reinterpreted Tyrolean cuisine, regional and seasonal, from almost forgotten local produce to great meats, with real room given to vegetables.
2027-01-14|24e Bendura Bank Snow Polo Wo.sej_exp0: Heliport at Erpfendorf, near Kitzbühel: VIP transfers, taxi flights and private scenic flights over the Kitzbühel Alps — the tournament's exact setting seen from above. 2026-08-15|Midsummer Gala at Villa d'Est.sej_pitch: On 15 August 2026, Villa d'Este opens its ten hectares of centuries-old gardens for the Midsummer Gala, its Ferragosto evening: a wandering aperitif through the lakeside gardens, then a gala dinner set around the floating pool — the first on Lake Como, inaugurated with the Sporting Club in 1965. At the evening's peak, the fireworks reflect across the waters of the lake. Count on 650 € per person, wine pairings and show included, in required elegant dress: jacket, long trousers and closed shoes for gentlemen. One single address, Via Regina 40 in Cernobbio, and the whole western shore of Lake Como to carry the night on.
2026-08-15|Midsummer Gala at Villa d'Est.sej_hotels0: Sleep where the gala takes place, Via Regina 40 in Cernobbio. 151 rooms split between the Cardinal's Building (124 rooms, designed in 1568) and the Queen's Pavilion (27 rooms and suites, 1856), set in a ten-hectare park. The Sporting Club and its floating pool — the first on Lake Como, inaugurated in 1965 —, a Beauty Center with physiotherapists and beauticians, a 24-hour gym, tennis and water sports. Private heliport and private landing stage on the lake; the public Cernobbio pier is a five-minute walk away.

Only 24 rooms and suites spread between the Villa, the Palazz (former stables, 8 rooms) and the lakeside Casa al Lago (4 suites), amid seven acres of terraced gardens leading down to the pool terrace. The wellness area occupies the vaulted ground floor of the Palazz, with sauna and steam bath. Ranked No. 4 in the World's 50 Best Hotels 2025 and honoured that same year with the Best Boutique Hotel and Best Hotel in Europe awards. The composer Vincenzo Bellini counts among its historic guests.

2026-08-15|Midsummer Gala at Villa d'Est.sej_tables1: One MICHELIN star, chef Andrea Casali. 2027-05-21|Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'E.ds: Born on the shores of the Lario in 1929, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este remains the most refined gathering in the world of collector cars. A jury of experts judges cars chosen for their authenticity, historical significance and beauty, in the gardens of the palace hotel and then in the neighbouring park of Villa Erba. Collectors, coachbuilders and dealers from around the world meet there for a weekend. Villa d'Este announces the opening of the 2027 edition on Friday 21 May; the detailed programme and ticketing are published closer to the date.

Access packages are published closer to the date on the official Concorso website and relayed by Villa d'Este, access to the palace hotel's gardens historically remaining the most sought after. To be notified of the opening, register your interest from winter onwards with Villa d'Este, on +39 031 34 81 or at info@villadeste.it, and keep an eye on concorsodeleganzavilladeste.com.

2027-05-21|Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'E.sej_pitch: In late May 2027, the gardens of Villa d'Este reopen for the most prestigious of automotive concours d'elegance: beneath century-old magnolias and wisteria, exceptional coachwork parades before the jury, with the waters of the Lario as the only backdrop. Organised by Villa d'Este and the BMW Group, the event continues all weekend in the park of Villa Erba, also in Cernobbio, where collectors and clubs display their machines under the foliage. Here the art of arriving matters as much as the arrival: a mahogany launch from the pontile, dinner facing the lake, and that late-May light that Lake Como gives only once a year. (The exact dates of the 2027 edition have not yet been published by the organiser: to be confirmed before booking.)
2027-05-21|Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'E.sej_hotels0: The very stage of the Concorso: the cars parade in the hotel's park, in Cernobbio (Via Regina 40). A 16th-century residence that became a hotel more than 150 years ago, with 151 rooms and suites spread between the Cardinal's Building, the Queen's Pavilion and four private villas; five places to drink and dine, including the Veranda, the Grill and Il Platano. The Sporting Club, opened in the 1960s, is home to Lake Como's first floating swimming pool — a teak platform set on the water and linked to the shore by a wooden walkway — alongside a beauty centre, a 24-hour gym and eight tennis courts, six of them clay.
2027-05-21|Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'E.sej_hotels1: An 18th-century villa in Moltrasio, a few kilometres from Cernobbio on the same western shore: just 24 rooms and suites, divided between the main villa, the Palazz (the former stables, eight rooms) and Casa al Lago, whose four suites border the water. Terraced gardens descending to the lake, a pool terrace above the water, a spa carved into an underground passage with sauna and hammam. Fourth in The World's 50 Best Hotels 2025 and Best Boutique Hotel Award 2024 and 2025; Vincenzo Bellini is among its guests of the past, and the suite bearing his name houses a grand piano.
2027-05-21|Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'E.sej_tables0: One Michelin star since 2018, in the centre of Cernobbio, Via Trieste 1/b — the very village of Villa d'Este and Villa Erba. Opened in 2016 by chef Davide Caranchini with Ambra, Marco and Luca: contemporary, research-driven cooking, strongly vegetable-led and nourished by the lake's produce. Caranchini was named chef of the year in 2023. Lunch and dinner service, Wednesday to Sunday.
2027-05-21|Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'E.sej_tables1: One Michelin star since 2017, on the water's edge in Torno (Via Torrazza 10), on the shore opposite Cernobbio — the crossing by boat is part of the pleasure. 2027-05-21|Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'E.sej_exp0: Take-off from the Como seaplane base (Viale Massenzio Masia 44), a few minutes from Cernobbio, with an operator working closely with the Aero Club Como, the oldest seaplane school still active in the world. Three routes on a Cessna 206 (5 passengers and 320 kg maximum): 30 minutes Como–Bellagio–Varenna–Menaggio–Argegno, 60 minutes as far as Colico and Piona, or 90 minutes on a grand tour of the lakes (Como, Annone, Pusiano, Alserio, Montorfano). Official rates from 480 €, 960 € and 1 440 € for two passengers.

Packages from one to six hours depending on the route, captain included: the way to reach Cernobbio by water on Concorso days.

2027-05-16|Falstaff — 130e anniversaire.ds: The Teatro Massimo, Italy's largest opera house, celebrates its one hundred and thirtieth anniversary by reviving the very work that inaugurated it on 16 May 1897: Verdi's Falstaff. The evening falls exactly on the anniversary date and is, according to the foundation, the high point of the 2026-27 season, which also marks thirty years since the 1997 reopening. The season, presented on 30 June 2026 in the Salone Belmonte of the Villa Igiea, opens with Samson et Dalila and includes a Macbeth conducted by Riccardo Muti.

2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.dt: Thursday 4 February 2027: doors at 20:15, opening at 22:00, ends at 05:00
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.ds: Once a year the auditorium of the Vienna State Opera is dismantled and covered with a parquet floor to become the most famous ballroom in the world. The 69th Wiener Opernball is held under the patronage of Federal President Alexander Van der Bellen. The programme is timed to the minute: guests enter at 20:15, the Federal President arrives at 21:00, the opening ceremony by the debutants' committee at 22:00, "Alles Walzer" at 22:45 releases the floor, the midnight quadrille, then two more quadrilles before the end at 05:00. Nine floors, five dance floors, twenty bars and buffets. Strict dress code: floor-length ball gown for women (any colour, but no Tracht or Festdirndl), black tailcoat, white shirt, white bow tie and black patent shoes for men — the Galauniform is accepted. The evening is broadcast live by Austrian public television (ORF).
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.sw: Europe's most-watched night: the Vienna Opera turned into a ballroom, white tie compulsory, boxes at 27 000 €.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.p: Sold exclusively by the Opernball-Büro of the Wiener Staatsoper: the official site states there is no other point of sale. Individual entrance cards (435 €, including a 35 € solidarity contribution to "Österreich hilft Österreich", maximum 4 per person, no seat) are allocated by draw; the registration window for 2027 ran from 1 June at 10:00 to 5 June 2026 at 23:59 and is now closed. Table seats (665 € per seat, the 435 € entrance card included, maximum 6 per person, room of your choice) went on sale on 24 June 2026 at 10:00 on a first-come, first-served basis. That leaves the boxes, sold only directly by the ball office: circle box 27 000 €, double stage box 25 000 €, premium stage box and premium box table 19 000 €, single stage box and single box table 15 000 €. Each category carries a pre-emption right reserved for patrons of the Freundeskreis (Partner+ 8 250 €, Benefactor+ 11 000 €, Donatoren 33 000 €) — the surest way in for future editions. Possible addition: spectator cards to watch the opening from the balcony or gallery, 110 to 290 €. In July and August the office replies only by email.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.pe: Organisation: Wiener Staatsoper — Opernball-Büro. Under the patronage of Federal President Alexander Van der Bellen. Opening by the debutants' committee (Eröffnungskomitee), recruited by audition. For decades the ball was the stage for Richard Lugner's international guests (Sophia Loren, Gina Lollobrigida, Kim Kardashian); he died in 2024.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.iv_o: Opernball-Büro der Wiener Staatsoper — the only distribution channel for entrance cards, table seats and boxes (the official site rules out any other point of sale)
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.iv_g: No free invitations are published. The only non-commercial route is applying to the opening committee (Eröffnungskomitee): free registration at opernball.at, open from 1 June to 16 September 2026 — so still open today. Applications as a couple only, both partners aged between 18 and 27 on the day of the ball, mastery of the left-turning waltz required, and never having opened the ball before. Audition, then compulsory rehearsals on 30 and 31 January 2027 (plus 17, 23 and 24 January for couples from Vienna, Lower Austria, Upper Austria and Burgenland), dress rehearsal on 3 February 2027. If admitted, participation costs 140 € per person.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.iv_w: Boxes from the Opernball-Büro: 27 000 € for a circle box, 25 000 € for a double stage box, 19 000 € for a premium stage box or box table, 15 000 € for a single stage box or box table; membership of the Freundeskreis of the Wiener Staatsoper (Partner+ 8 250 €, Benefactor+ 11 000 €, Donatoren 33 000 €) opens the pre-emption right on these boxes. Entrance cards 435 € by draw (registration closed for 2027), table seats 665 € including the card, spectator cards 110 to 290 €.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.sej_pitch: On 4 February 2027 the Wiener Staatsoper stops being a theatre: in some thirty hours the stalls seats disappear, a ball floor is laid and 650 floral arrangements dress the boxes for the 69th Wiener Opernball. At 22:00 the fanfare announces the entrance of the Jungdamen- und Herrenkomitee — about 150 couples in white gowns and tailcoats — who open the ball to Ziehrer's Fächerpolonaise, before the famous "Alles Walzer" hands the floor to some 5 000 guests. Seven hours of waltzing follow across eight dance spaces, with quadrilles at midnight, 02:00 and 04:00, until the end at 05:00. White tie for the gentlemen, long gowns for the ladies: in Vienna, etiquette is part of the show.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.sej_hotels0: Philharmonikerstraße 4, right behind the Staatsoper: you cross the street in ball dress. A Viennese address since 1876, awarded 3 Michelin Keys and listed among the 50 Best Hotels of the World 2025. Suites with a view, including the Opera Penthouse Suite, the Madame Butterfly Suite and the Wiener Philharmoniker Suite. Sacher Boutique Spa (Seed to Skin and Royal Fern treatments, massages, sauna, hammam, fitness), the Rote Bar and Grüne Bar restaurants, the Blaue Bar, and Café Sacher with the Original Sacher-Torte.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.sej_hotels1: Kärntner Ring 9, on the Ringstraße, a three-minute walk from the Opera — close enough to walk home at dawn in heels. Opened in 1870. The terrace restaurant 1870 (Austrian fusion cuisine) and the Japanese table Unkai, both awarded two toques by Gault&Millau; also the Grand Brasserie, the Unkai sushi bar and the Rosengarten café. Wellness area with gym, sauna and steam bath, plus a Ladies Only zone.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.sej_tables0: Three Michelin stars since 2025 — one of only two Austrian tables at this level, along with Amador. The house of Birgit and Heinz Reitbauer, contemporary Austrian cuisine fed by the restaurant's rooftop kitchen garden, the imperial orangery of Schönbrunn and the family farm at the Pogusch. Am Heumarkt 2a, in the heart of the Stadtpark, about ten minutes from the Opera. Service Monday to Friday, lunch and dinner; reservation essential.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.sej_tables1: Two Michelin stars: the first in 2014, the second in 2018. Greek-Austrian chef Konstantin Filippou, born in Graz to an Austrian mother and a Greek father, serves contemporary cuisine here; Gault&Millau Chef of the Year in 2016. Dominikanerbastei 17, in the 1st district, about fifteen minutes on foot from the Opera. Open Monday and Thursday to Saturday, lunch and dinner — note, closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.sej_exp0: The reference dance school in Vienna, founded in 1919 and housed in the Palais Pallavicini (Bräunerstraße 13). On the programme: "Ball Express Courses" to revise the essential ball dances in three sessions, specific Viennese waltz training designed as preparation for ball openings, tailor-made private lessons and an etiquette strand (seminars and etiquette dinners). Enough to arrive at the Opernball knowing how to turn left, as they do at the opening.
2027-02-04|69. Wiener Opernball.sej_exp1: The morning training of the riders and their Lipizzaner stallions in the baroque Winterreitschule of the Hofburg (Michaelerplatz 1), accompanied by classical Viennese music. An imperial hour with no staging: the real work, suppling exercises and figures repeated tirelessly, in one of the most beautiful riding halls in the world, about ten minutes on foot from the Opera. Sessions at 10:00 or 11:30 depending on the date, tickets 18 to 29 €.

2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.dt: Monday 25 January 2027: doors at 20:00, opening at 21:00, ends at 05:00
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.ds: For more than a century, the last Monday in January has belonged to the Jägerball, the ball of the Grünes Kreuz, which takes over both the state rooms of the Hofburg and the baroque riding hall of the Spanish Riding School. This is the great gathering of the Austrian hunting world, with some five thousand guests: here white tie gives way to country dress. The dress code is strict and checked at the door — dirndl or Tracht covering the knee for women, no leather breeches; hunting dinner jacket (bow tie permitted), Tracht suit or knee-length leather breeches with jacket and tie for men. The 104th edition is held under the patronage of the Province of Styria. Entry of the guests of honour and opening ceremony by the Jungdamen- und Jungherrenkomitee at 21:00, second opening at the Spanish Riding School at 23:00, tombola at 23:55, midnight quadrille in the Festsaal, public quadrille in the riding hall at 01:00.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.sw: The ball of the hunting world: Hofburg and Spanish Riding School, dirndl and Tracht, five thousand guests until 05:00.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.p: Written booking with the Verein Grünes Kreuz, care of Barbara Payer, secretary general: requests open on Monday 7 September 2026 at 10:00 and are processed from early November 2026; any order exceeding the quota moves automatically to the waiting list. The request must state full contact details including mobile number, number of cards, table requirement, billing address and collection method. Entrance card €210 (€100 for ages 16-24, €50 for the opening committee); it gives access to all areas but includes no seating. Seating is charged separately: from €40 per person in the Hofburg (tables of up to ten), €85 per person at the Spanish Riding School (round tables of eight) — where the best tables are found. Cards collected in Vienna in autumn 2026 or sent by post.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.pe: Organisation: Verein Grünes Kreuz, Vienna 1st district (Barbara Payer, secretary general). The 2027 edition is under the patronage of the Province of Styria. Opening committee recruited by audition at the Tanzschule Elmayer (young women 16-24, young men 17-24), rehearsals compulsory.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.iv_o: Verein Grünes Kreuz — Jägerball office, Führichgasse 8/4/8, 1010 Vienna (Barbara Payer, secretary general)

Rehearsals compulsory, including the third on Sunday 24 January 2027 from 16:00 to 18:00 and the dress rehearsal on Monday 25 January 2027 from 18:00 to 20:00, both in the Hofburg.
2027-01-25|104. Requests exceeding the quota go onto the waiting list.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.sej_pitch: On the last Monday in January, the Hofburg and the Spanish Riding School open for the Jägerball – Ball vom Grünen Kreuz, born in 1905 out of mutual aid among hunters around Prince Alexander zu Solms-Braunfels. For this 104th edition under the patronage of Styria, some 5,000 guests in silk dirndl and loden spread through the imperial state rooms, the opening staged at 21:00 by the house of Elmayer. At 23:00 the solemn opening unfolds beneath the chandeliers of the baroque Winterreitschule — the white hall where the Lipizzaner stallions usually parade, and which becomes for one night the most improbable of dance floors.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.sej_hotels0: Petersplatz 7, 1010 Vienna, in the heart of the old town: about five minutes on foot via the Graben and the Kohlmarkt to Michaelerplatz and the Hofburg entrance — the shortest route to the ballroom. Viennese suites including the St. Stephen's Suite, Asaya spa, Neue Hoheit restaurant and bar on the upper floors (the bar on the sixth), and the THE1835 rooftop with its cocktails facing the roofs of the Innere Stadt.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.sej_hotels1: Philharmonikerstraße 4, 1010 Vienna, opposite the State Opera: the Hofburg is a five- to ten-minute walk along the Albertina. A house opened in 1876, home of the Original Sacher-Torte, distinguished with three Michelin Keys. Dining in the Rote Bar and the Grüne Bar, plus the Café Sacher; Sacher Boutique Spa with hammam, sauna and gym — useful on waking, since a Viennese ball ends very late.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.sej_tables0: Three stars in the Guide Michelin Austria 2026 and 33rd in the World's 50 Best 2025. Heinz Reitbauer at the helm, brigade led by Michael Bauböck, in a mirrored glass pavilion grafted onto a 1904 building, the former dairy of the Stadtpark — Am Heumarkt 2A, 1030 Vienna, a few minutes by car from the Hofburg. Its name, "the Styrian corner", echoes the Styrian patronage of this 104th edition.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.sej_tables1: Two Michelin stars, Coburgbastei 4, 1010 Vienna, about ten minutes' walk from the Hofburg. Since 2011 Silvio Nickol has signed tasting menus blending French elegance, Asian nuances and regional produce. Beneath the palace, now a hotel-residence, six cellars hold more than 60,000 bottles. Reservation essential.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.sej_exp0: See by day the hall where you will dance by night. The Morgenarbeit takes place in the baroque Winterreitschule, Michaelerplatz 1: the Lipizzaner stallions work there to classical Viennese music, from still-dark young horses to accomplished "white stars". Session of about an hour, at 10:00; tickets online or at the school's box office.
2027-01-25|104. Jägerball – Ball vom Grü.sej_exp1: The institution that stages the opening of the Jägerball — set for Monday 25 January 2027 at 21:00 in the Hofburg — housed since 1919 in the Palais Pallavicini, Bräunerstraße 13, a step from the Hofburg. Viennese waltz classes, express pre-ball courses and opening committee rehearsals: the only way to arrive at the ball knowing how to turn left.

2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.dt: Thursday 21 January 2027: doors at 9 pm, start at 10 pm, close at 5 am
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.ds: Three weeks after the New Year's Concert, the most filmed orchestra in the world steps down from the podium to set its guests dancing in the halls of the Musikverein. The Wiener Philharmoniker themselves play the solemn opening, before handing the night over to the Orchester Wolfgang Steubl and the Tom Henkes Dance Band. The entrance and dance of the Jungdamen- und Jungherrenkomitee, trained and led by the Tanzschule Elmayer under Thomas Schäfer-Elmayer, is one of the high points of the evening every year — floor-length white gown and white gloves for the young ladies, black tailcoat and white gloves for their partners. Dress code for guests: floor-length evening gown, white tie or Austrian gala uniform. Capacity is tight, the atmosphere more intimate and more musical than at the Hofburg.
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.sw: The only ball where the New Year's Concert orchestra comes down from the stage to set its guests dancing, beneath the gilding of the Musikverein.
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.p: The boxes are the real key, and the calendar is tight: box orders are placed exclusively in writing, by post or email, addressed to the Wiener Philharmoniker in August — so within the coming days for the 2027 edition — with allocation subject to availability and all requests placed in a waiting queue. Official prices: parterre box €18,000 (10 people) or €15,600 (8 people), standing parterre box €8,000 (8 people), premium balcony box €14,520 (12 people), balcony box €8,000 (8 people), Belvedere box €6,000 (6 people). Boxes are booked only in full and may be passed on only with the orchestra's agreement. Tables, open for booking by email since 6 October 2025 (€180 a seat in the Stehparterre, €125 in the Brahms-Saal, €110 in the side Stehparterre, €105 in the Loggia, the Gottfried-von-Einem hall and the PORR mirror hall), are all announced as sold out. Entrance cards go on sale only from 11 January 2027, at the Wiener Philharmoniker box office (Kärntner Ring 12, Monday to Friday 9:30 am to 3:30 pm) and online; before that date they are issued only with a table booking — no sales by email and no pre-reservation are possible. Prices: €220 for a lady's or gentleman's card, €170 for the midnight entrance (access from 0:30 am, offline only), €75 for students up to the age of 27 inclusive, €65 for the opening committee. Entrance cards must be bought in addition to table seats and boxes.
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.pe: Organisation: Wiener Philharmoniker. Solemn opening by the orchestra (conductor not yet announced). Ball orchestras: Orchester Wolfgang Steubl, Tom Henkes Dance Band. Opening committee trained and led by the Tanzschule Elmayer, overall direction Thomas Schäfer-Elmayer, rehearsals at the Musikverein in the week before the ball.
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.iv_o: Wiener Philharmoniker — Kartenbüro and ball office, Kärntner Ring 12, 1010 Vienna
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.iv_g: No complimentary invitations. The only reduced-rate route is the opening committee, by online registration directly with the Tanzschule Elmayer from September, as a couple only, with a compulsory audition in the autumn (committee card €65). Minimum age 17 for young women, 18 for young men; command of the left-turning waltz required; married couples are not admitted. Attendance is compulsory at all rehearsals, at the Musikverein, in the week before the ball.
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.iv_w: Box order in writing, by post or email, addressed to the Wiener Philharmoniker in the August before the ball (€6,000 to €18,000 depending on the box, allocation subject to availability and placed in a waiting queue). Table seats (€105 to €180) are sold out for 2027. Individual cards from 11 January 2027 at the box office, Kärntner Ring 12, and online, €220.
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.sej_pitch: On 21 January 2027 the Golden Hall of the Musikverein — the hall of the New Year's Concert — trades its seats for a ballroom floor and disappears beneath countless floral arrangements: this is the 84th Ball of the Wiener Philharmoniker. From the balcony, the orchestra's brass sound the fanfare Richard Strauss composed for the very first ball, in 1924, played at every edition since. The debutantes in long white gowns and their partners in black tailcoats enter to a polonaise by Chopin or Ziehrer; then the dancing master pronounces the evening's only official words — "Alles Walzer!". Guests then waltz until the small hours with the Großes Wiener Ballorchester, relieved by a big band, with a quadrille at midnight repeated at 2 am; elsewhere in the house, a Viennese Heuriger and a discotheque set up in the Metal Hall. Card sales open on 11 January 2027, at the orchestra's office, Kärntner Ring 12, and online.
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.sej_hotels0: Kärntner Ring 16, a few hundred metres from the Musikverein, across the Ring: the palace built between 1862 and 1865 for Duke Philipp of Württemberg was turned into a hotel and inaugurated on 28 April 1873, in the presence of Franz Joseph and Elisabeth, for the Vienna World's Fair. The house offers a butler service, the Café Imperial Wien (7 am-11 pm daily), which serves the Imperial-Torte and one of the best Wiener Schnitzel in town, the Imperial Bar (9 am-1 am) with its daily afternoon tea, and a 24-hour gym. The ball's card office is two doors away, at Kärntner Ring 12.
2027-01-21|84. Ball der Wiener Philharmo.sej_hotels1: Five minutes' walk from the Musikverein, Philharmoniker Straße 4, just behind the State Opera: the house, opened in 1876, has 152 rooms and suites designed one by one by co-owner Alexandra Winkler with decorator Pierre-Yves Rochon. The Sacher Boutique Spa brings together a sauna area, steam bath, 24-hour gym and treatments by appointment (7 days a week, 11 am-7 pm). 2027-02-22|ICI Travels: Uruguay.sej_pitch: Seven days in February when contemporary art leaves the gallery wall to follow the Atlantic coast: ICI Travels opens the doors of the Museo Nacional de Artes Visuales and of private collections in Montevideo, then heads down to José Ignacio for the Fundación Ama Amoedo, the Museo de Arte Contemporáneo Atchugarry and artists' studios, between dinners orchestrated by the local cultural scene. On site, you sleep at Playa Vik José Ignacio, on Mansa beach, minutes from Bahía Vik: the main building by Carlos Ott, a bronze door by Pablo Atchugarry, a collection of Uruguayan and international art — the hotel is already an exhibition. The trip was built with Laura Bardier, a member of the ICI board of trustees and founder of the ESTE ARTE fair: the key that opens the doors you cannot push alone.
2027-02-22|ICI Travels: Uruguay.sej_hotels0: On Mansa beach, in José Ignacio, about 20 km north-east of Punta del Este and minutes from Bahía Vik. The main building, "Sculpture", is by Carlos Ott, the Uruguayan architect: a bronze entrance door by Pablo Atchugarry and a major collection of Uruguayan and international contemporary art. Sixteen suites in all: three master suites in the main building and six casas of two to three bedrooms. Cantilevered pool of about 23 metres in black Uruguayan granite, its floor tracing a star map of the southern hemisphere in points of light. The Cielomar restaurant faces the ocean and is presented by the house as Uruguay's first 100% gluten-free restaurant; The Shack spa, shared across the Vik collection, is at Bahía Vik.
2027-02-22|ICI Travels: Uruguay.sej_hotels1: A small house of eight rooms and suites in José Ignacio itself (Paseo del Marinero), private gardens, terraces or ocean views, vintage furniture sourced in Montevideo and Buenos Aires in the 1950s-60s spirit of Saint-Tropez and Monte-Carlo. Above all: it shares its grounds with Ta Khut, a James Turrell Skyspace inaugurated in November 2021, access to which is offered to guests of the posada at reserved times. The perfect address to extend an art trip.
2027-02-22|ICI Travels: Uruguay.sej_tables0: The institution of José Ignacio, feet in the sand of Playa Brava — address and contact details confirmed on its official site. (Uruguay is not covered by the Michelin Guide; the regional benchmark is Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants, where La Huella appears on the extended list, 83rd in the latest published ranking.) Grilled catch of the day, ceviches, tempuras, sushi and parrilla, lunches that stretch out over rosé. Booking essential in February.
2027-02-22|ICI Travels: Uruguay.sej_tables1: Playa Vik's restaurant, facing the ocean, right where you are staying: cuisine announced by the house as 100% gluten-free, unique in Uruguay. Handy for dinner without getting back on the road, between two studio visits.
2027-02-22|ICI Travels: Uruguay.sej_exp0: The third house of the Vik collection, 9 km (5.6 miles) from Playa Vik and Bahía Vik, on around 1,600 hectares (4,000 acres) of countryside. You ride out with the gauchos on criollo horses and quarter horses, take a polo lesson on the private field (matches for experienced riders), then lunch at El Asador, around the central fire, temple of the Uruguayan barbecue. The setting is worth the trip: a 3.5-metre white marble sculpture by Pablo Atchugarry, a ceiling frieze by Clever Lara in the main living room, a chapel decorated by Carlos Musso.
2027-02-22|ICI Travels: Uruguay.sej_exp1: On the hills of Garzón, in the hinterland of Maldonado. On its official experiences page the estate offers the Single Vineyard Tour, the Garzón Premium Experience and the Garzón Reserva Tour, a blending workshop assessed by one of the bodega's sommeliers, a picnic in the vines and a cooking class around the Francis Mallmann fires with the restaurant team, ending in a four-course lunch. The estate has its own restaurant, with tastings and exclusive wines to match.
