2026-11-10|133° Campeonato Argentino Abi.sej_pitch: Since 1893, the Abierto de Palermo has been the absolute summit of world polo: the stage where teams reach the maximum handicap of 40 goals. From 10 November to 12 December 2026, the 133rd edition is played at the Campo Argentino de Polo — "the Cathedral of polo", opened in 1928, up to 30,000 spectators — and closes with a December final that seals Argentina's Triple Crown, after Tortugas and Hurlingham. The stadium stands in the heart of Palermo, on Avenida del Libertador, the artery that runs straight down to the grand hotels of Recoleta.
2026-11-10|133° Campeonato Argentino Abi.sej_hotels0: Posadas 1086/88, in Recoleta, one street from Avenida del Libertador — the artery that runs up to the Campo Argentino de Polo, about 4 km away. The hotel combines a contemporary tower with La Mansión Álzaga Unzué, an early twentieth-century private mansion. On site: the parrilla Elena — named after Elena Peña Unzué, the bride who received La Mansión as a wedding gift — renowned for its aged meats and listed in the MICHELIN Guide; the traditional asado of Nuestro Secreto; a spa with private treatment rooms and a hydrotherapy circuit; and the Pony Line bar, whose name is borrowed from polo vocabulary.
2026-11-10|133° Campeonato Argentino Abi.sej_hotels1: Avenida Alvear 1661, the most aristocratic address in Recoleta, about 4 km from the Campo Argentino de Polo. Two buildings — the palace built in 1934 by architect León Dourge for the brothers Luis and Alberto Duhau, French-inspired neoclassical modelled on the Château du Marais, and a contemporary wing — linked by large terraced gardens. The Ahín Wellness & Spa offers massages, private treatments, meditation, a swimming pool and a gym; Duhau Restaurante & Vinoteca, recognised by the MICHELIN Guide, serves meats, fish and seasonal produce over a wood fire, with La Vinoteca adding its cheese cellar and wine-and-cheese tastings. The Piano Nobile salons, with their original frescoes and wood panelling, serve afternoon tea.
2026-11-10|133° Campeonato Argentino Abi.sej_tables0: One star in the MICHELIN Guide Argentina, awarded in the inaugural 2024 edition and retained in 2025 and 2026. The parrilla of Pablo Rivero, who founded it in 1998: Guatemala 4699, on the corner of Gurruchaga, in Palermo Viejo — the same barrio as the stadium, some 2.5 km away. Aged meats, walls of signed bottles, long-term work with its breeders and producers. Booking strongly advised, well in advance.
2026-11-10|133° Campeonato Argentino Abi.sej_tables1: One star in the MICHELIN Guide Argentina, awarded in 2025 and retained in 2026. Fitz Roy 1819, in Palermo Hollywood, about 2 km from the Campo Argentino de Polo. Chef and co-founder Gabriel Oggero spent years developing the cultivation and service of the Patagonian oyster in Buenos Aires — served raw or cooked — alongside contemporary cuisine built on seasonal Argentine produce, an urban kitchen garden and a cellar of more than 15,000 bottles. Dinner only, Monday to Saturday, from 19:00 to 23:00.
2026-11-10|133° Campeonato Argentino Abi.sej_exp0: A Relais & Châteaux member estancia at San Antonio de Areco, 120 km from Buenos Aires, deep in the Pampas. Its origins go back to 1830, when it was one of the posting houses of the "Camino Real"; it became an estancia in the early twentieth century, was listed as heritage of San Antonio de Areco in 1970 and fully renovated in 2009. Eleven rooms and suites, each named after a polo horse, overlooking the park or the polo fields. Two fields on the property, an international polo team based there and, in season, practice and matches almost daily; excursions on horseback, by carriage or by mountain bike, and a large swimming pool. The natural extension of a day at Palermo, Pampas side.
2026-11-10|133° Campeonato Argentino Abi.sej_exp1: An operator based at the Helinorth-Helipower heliport in Don Torcuato, north of Buenos Aires, claiming 18 years of activity and more than 2,000 flights flown. Private flights for 3 to 6 passengers: scenic flights over Buenos Aires, Tigre and the Paraná delta, Isla Martín García, links to Uruguay and private charter — the way to reach a polo estancia in the Pampas without taking the road. Contact and booking 24/7 (WhatsApp, telephone, email).

The committee studies the file, notifies its decision by email, then invites successful candidates to pay a one-off initiation fee of 250 USD. The festival package is then offered to members according to three published tiers: 2,200 USD ("Eager", April-June 2026), 2,600 USD ("Relaxed", July-August 2026) and 3,000 USD ("Snooze", October-November 2026). All requests go through hello@ondalinda.com.

Between two nights, Careyes remains what it is: a private enclave of ochre and cobalt villas suspended above the Pacific, 1 hr 30 by road from Manzanillo, 15 minutes from the Chamela airstrip, entrance at km 53.5 of Highway 200. 2026-11-12|Ondalinda x Careyes — Cosmic.sej_hotels1: Estate of more than 2,000 acres in a nature reserve with four pristine private beaches, in Costalegre, Jalisco, on the Carretera Federal 200 km 82 — some thirty kilometres from the entrance to Careyes (km 53.5), 30 to 40 minutes by road. 2026-11-12|Ondalinda x Careyes — Cosmic.sej_tables1: The table of El Careyes Club & Residences, on a quiet deck overlooking the Pacific, in the very heart of Careyes and therefore minutes from the Ondalinda nights. 2026-11-12|Ondalinda x Careyes — Cosmic.sej_exp0: Careyes slips between two international airports: Manzanillo (ZLO) about 1 hr 30 by road, Puerto Vallarta (PVR) 2 hr 30-3 hr. Polo lesson at 3,000 MXN, stick & ball at 1,200 MXN for 20 minutes, green fee at 200 USD (50 USD per chukker). Booking via concierge@careyes.com or +52 (315) 351 0240.
